description: The re-run of the Expectation paper's evaluation (rerun-plan 2026-11), gemma4:31b: vendor sampling (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 64), max_tokens 32,768, thinking high (D-21: on the gateway a cap of 16,384 thinking tokens), traffic and top-up in stage 1, known data only. The prompts are pinned to the versions current at the re-run's start (Skuld 0.12.1), dpv-purposes 2.3.1, the study's purpose map (extended after the run by `skuld purposes map`, rerun-plan §5 step 7). client.limits is per process: the gateway allows 100 requests in flight for gemma4:31b and 300 for qwen3.8:27b in all (D-22), so the orchestration runs at most 4 Skuld processes per family at once (4 x 25 gemma; 4 x 68 qwen, leaving 28 for Loki's 7 crawls).
